set.body: PRD X-13 through X-16. A non-empty nominal PredictorSet of Mass surfaces fits a Mass response with solver-specific output types: OLS to Signed, intercept-free NNLS to Intensity, simplex-constrained fit to Mass, and Signed residuals throughout. Intercept policy is explicit. Diagnostics are descriptive only; no coefficient standard errors or p-values. Partial Pearson or Spearman association is a separate result, and binomial GLM over continuous mass is excluded.
set.title: Surface decomposition and partial association
